name: Urabrask
title: Praetor of the Quiet Furnace
role: Dissenting red-aligned praetor and adversary of Elesh Norn
summary: A Phyrexian praetor who tolerated Mirran refugees and openly resisted Norn's forced unity.
biography: Unlike Norn, Urabrask allowed Mirran survivors to shelter within his furnaces and refused to impose a single form of obedience.
His opposition to the Machine Orthodoxy eventually became open rebellion, with alliances formed across deep ideological divisions.
Norn's brutal punishment of her rival showed the violence underlying her proclamation that all Phyrexians shared one will.

Urabrask was a praetor of New Phyrexia whose furnace-layer philosophy differed sharply from Elesh Norn's. The presence of Mirran survivors in his territory showed the limits of the claim that every Phyrexian power center pursued identical policies toward non-Phyrexian life.

His revolt created opportunities for opposition to Norn, but it would be misleading to make him simply another Mirran freedom fighter. His aims emerged from conflicts within Phyrexia and did not erase the deeper differences between the rebels who cooperated against the Machine Orthodoxy.

The punishment inflicted upon him dramatized the cost of dissent inside a supposedly united civilization. It also helps explain the invasion's internal vulnerabilities: expanding into other worlds required Norn to demand obedience from rival leaders at home, not just to overcome defenders abroad.

featuredCard.significance: A 2023 retrospective illustration of the furnace praetor first introduced in 2011.
